name: squat
phone: On the floor or a low stand, 2 to 3 metres away, the whole body in the picture: side-on, from the front, or in between.

ready.from: Standing tall: the knees within 20 degrees of straight (the usual definition; not fitted).
Standing tall: the trunk within 20 degrees of upright (the usual definition; not fitted).

rules.name: depth

standard.source: The hips sink at least this far, in legs, when both knees bend to 114 degrees, the knees' number: a hip stands no higher above its ankle than a leg bent so allows, thigh and shin of equal length (Drillis and Contini, as Winter gives them: 0.245 and 0.246 of the height): 1 - sin(57 degrees) = 0.161.

rules.unseen: Keep your whole body in view.
rules.from: Set by movement-check from the form standard, 0.161 (its source beside it), the least the body allows, so with no room of its own; rounded the forgiving way. The people's shallowest rep reads 0.22.

rules.name: knees bent

standard.source: A quarter squat bends the knees to an inner angle of 110 to 140 degrees, a half squat to 80 to 100, a parallel squat to 60 to 70 (Front Sports Act Living 2024, a scoping review of the deep squat, PMC11618833); Kd's research file asks for about 90. The line is the quarter squat's deepest end, 110, plus the camera's own room (the forgiving way): a rep read at 114 or deeper counts.

rules.unseen: Keep your whole body in view.
rules.from: Set by movement-check from the form standard, 110 (its source beside it), plus the camera's own room on this reading: the same rep's change from as filmed to each replay that sets numbers, in 99 reps of 100 (313 reps, 9 people): 3.88; rounded the forgiving way. Their shallowest rep reads 107.36.
